question: Telemedicine and type 1 diabetes: is technology per se sufficient to improve glycaemic control?
reference_answer: Yes. The Diabeo system improved glycaemic control in both high and low users who avidly used the IDA function, while the greatest improvement was seen in the low users who had the motivational support of teleconsultations.
